claims.source_quote_ar: جعلت اللعنة تابعة لهم في الدارين
claims.claim_ar: عرض اللعنة بأنها تابعة لهم "في الدارين"، أي متتابعة في الدنيا والآخرة، لربط مصير المعنى عبر حقلين زمانيين وإظهار شمول العقاب.
claims.claim_en: The curse is presented as "following them in both abodes (في الدارين)", linking this-world and the Hereafter to emphasize an enduring, cross‑temporal punishment.
claims.needs_review_reason: Mapping the phrase 'في الدارين' to the specific ma'ani subtype 'fasl_wasl' is interpretive; another reader might label this as a different ma'ani technique (e.g., itnaab).
claims.rhetorical_effect: links temporally separated spheres (worlds) to amplify the severity and permanence of the curse; encourages strong affective response and moral warning.

claims.source_quote_ar: وتكرارها مع النداء على كفرهم والدعاء عليهم
claims.claim_ar: تكرار جذر «رفد» في التركيب «الرِّفْدُ الْمَرْفُودُ» كتكرار لفظي ودلالي لتوكيد الذمّ وقوة الحكم.
claims.claim_en: Repetition of the root 'رفد' in the phrase 'الرِّفْدُ الْمَرْفُودُ' (active noun + passive participle) functions as repetition, intensifying condemnation and rhetorical force.
claims.rhetorical_effect: intensifies reproach and vividness of the punishment by morphological echo; creates emphatic, memorable phrasing.

claims.claim_ar: الإيجاز في عبارة «بئس الرِّفْدُ الْمَرْفُودُ» يؤدي إلى تهويل وتفظيع الحالة؛ الصياغة الموجزة تضاعف وقع الحكم.
claims.claim_en: The concise phrasing ('بِئْسَ الرِّفْدُ الْمَرْفُودُ') operates as ijaaz (conciseness), magnifying and terrifying the described situation—brevity increases rhetorical impact.
claims.needs_review_reason: Classifying this particular concision as 'ijaaz' is interpretive; some analysts might treat it as general emphatic style rather than the technical ijaaz device.
claims.rhetorical_effect: heightens intensity and horror through compressed, forceful wording; leaves strong affective impression with minimal wording.
